 What will you do 
As an Marine Painter at Flagship Shipyard in Amsterdam, you are responsible for the complete painting process of our boats, from preparation to flawless final finishing. You work on maintenance, repairs, and finishing of our own fleet as well as external projects, independently managing projects from start to finish. 
You assess surfaces, carry out surface preparation (sanding, filling, degreasing), apply primers and topcoats, and continuously monitor quality. You plan and organize your own work and ensure projects are delivered on time and in line with quality standards. 
You will work at our shipyard in Amsterdam North within a close-knit team, while maintaining a high level of independence and responsibility. With your craftsmanship, you directly contribute to the appearance, protection, and longevity of our electric and classic boats. We are open to both employment contracts and freelance (self-employed) collaboration. Your responsibilities 
As a ship painter, you independently carry out painting and coating work on and around our boats. Your tasks include: - 
Preparing surfaces (filling, sanding, degreasing, masking, and priming); - 
Inspecting, repairing, and preparing polyester, fiberglass, aluminum, and steel; - 
Applying paint, varnish, and coatings using brushes, rollers, and spray equipment; - 
Working with 1- and 2-component coatings, including mixing and color matching; - 
Monitoring project planning, quality, and progress; - 
Working safely according to guidelines and using personal protective equipment correctly; - 
Maintaining tools and recording materials and work performed; -
